description: Store or update a secret credential (API key, token, etc.) for a custom tool integration. Secrets are encrypted at rest.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the tool to add the secret to

key.description: Secret key name used in templates (e.g., 'API_KEY', 'AUTH_TOKEN')

value.description: Secret value to store securely (will be encrypted)

name: neuron_add_tool_secret
title: Add Tool Secret
